paragraphs.text: Ardoz is a legendary Goblin Shaman from Dominaria.

Ardoz is a character that was introduced as part of the Red Speedy deck in Jumpstart 2022 . She is a female goblin shaman and shoemaker from Dominaria known as the Cobbler of War. She wears brown clothing and has dark hair tied into a ponytail. She appears to have created rocket shoes that spew fire and propel her forward. On her card, she has an activated ability to create goblin tokens with haste and has a triggered ability that grants creatures additional power when they enter.
